'''The Moon Rises Over Water''' is a [[sword form]]. The movement of the sword form is a slashing movement. [[Rand al'Thor]] used this form when battling his reflections from a [[bubble of evil]] in the [[Stone of Tear]].{{ref/book|4|2}} Rand later used the form with a sword wrought from ''[[saidin]]'' in [[Rhuidean]] while escaping another bubble of evil with [[Matrim Cauthon]].{{ref/book|4|26}}
